title: Gold link ki timeline banao
instruction: Chaar historical cards earliest se latest lagao. Poora order gold link se modern fiat tak ka track kholega.

pieces.label: 1661 | Sweden | First banknotes
pieces.right: Book ki is timeline ka pehla milestone Sweden ke first banknotes hain.
pieces.wrong: 1661 ko baad mein rakhne se earlier banknotes milestone later events ke baad pahunch jaayega.

pieces.label: 1816 | Britain | Gold Standard
pieces.right: Sweden ke milestone ke baad Britain ka Gold Standard juda.
pieces.wrong: 1816 ko 1661 se pehle ya 1944 ke baad rakhne se historical order tootega.

pieces.label: 1944 | Bretton Woods | Dollar-gold
pieces.right: Dollar-gold link wala Bretton Woods milestone jud gaya.
pieces.wrong: 1944 ka dollar-gold milestone 1816 ke baad aur 1971 se pehle aayega.

pieces.label: 1971 | Modern fiat | No gold redemption
pieces.right: Modern fiat par gold redemption nahi: gold-backed paper se crucial difference saamne aaya.
pieces.wrong: 1971 ko pehle laane se gold-redemption ending uske earlier milestones se pehle aa jaayegi.

win: 1661 → 1816 → 1944 → 1971: milestones aur gold link ka badlav dono clear.
